prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” — the right AI video ad maker depends on what you need (realistic human presenters, social-format speed, budget, languages, creative control). Below are top options by use case plus quick guidance to pick one.

Top picks (strength & typical use)
- Synthesia / HeyGen — Best for realistic AI presenters and multilingual spoken ads. Great for B2B, training, product explainers with a talking person. Easy script → video. Paid plans.
- Canva (AI Video) / InVideo / Promo.com — Best for fast social ads (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok). Lots of templates, aspect-ratio presets, stock media, simple AI assist. Good for small businesses and marketers.
- Pictory / Lumen5 — Best for script- or blog-to-video workflows and repurposing long content into short ads. Good automated captioning and scene creation.
- Runway / Kaiber — Best for creative/generative visuals and advanced editing. Use when you want novel visuals, motion generation, and heavy editing control.
- Descript — Best when you want podcast-style editing, text-based video editing, and top-tier voice cloning/overdubs for precise spoken ads.
- Shakr / Promo.com (ad-focused platforms) — Best for high-conversion ad templates, dynamic product ads and scale (especially for e-commerce marketers).
- Clipchamp (Microsoft) / Canva Free tier — Good budget options with simple AI features and basic templates.

How to choose
- Need a talking human avatar or onboarding video → Synthesia or HeyGen.
- Need many short social creatives fast → Canva, InVideo, Promo, Shakr.
- Repurposing webinars/blogs → Pictory or Lumen5.
- Want advanced generative visuals or cinematic effects → Runway.
- Tight budget & DIY → Clipchamp or Canva free plan.
- Need custom voices / precise voice editing → Descript + Murf/Play.ht for TTS alternatives.

Other considerations
- Languages & accents: Synthesia/HeyGen support many; verify specific languages you need.
- Brand control: check brand-kit, fonts, and templates.
- Output formats: ensure vertical/square/16:9 presets for your ad platforms.
- Costs: many offer free trials but most high-quality AI presenters / exports require paid plans.
- API/scale: if you need automated ad generation at scale, check platform API and template automation (Shakr, Promo, some of the others).

Recommendation offer
Tell me: platform(s) you’ll run ads on (Instagram/TikTok/YouTube/etc.), budget, whether you want a real-looking presenter, and how many videos you need. I’ll recommend the single best tool and a short workflow (script → voice → video → captions) for your case.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
